translation: Took place in posad Serock, 21 April 1890, 9 PM. Appeared personally Jankiel Borensztejn, szkolnik, 36, and Jankiel Finkielsztejn, [shingle?] master, 30, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 8 PM in posad Serock died a child of male sex named Judka Hersz Hozenberg[?], son of Szaja[?] and Ryfka nee Kuczelowska[?], permanent residents of posad Kaluszyn temporarily residing in posad Serock, aged three years. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
